digest.component_or_area: local rebar LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles using AWS credentials and layered config files rather than deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL.
All three gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must parse verdicts, validate structured output, and resolve exclusively to Bedrock inference profiles with zero direct-Anthropic calls.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens (not write-only) to confirm genuine engagement rather than the bug f81d failure mode.
The Bedrock cachePoint TTL difference from Anthropic cache_control must be investigated and documented; both default to 5 minutes with no observable difference.
Opt-in and revert procedures must be documented in docs/local-dev-env.md and the revert must be executed and proven working in a single step.
No modifications to infra/ directory are permitted; the change must be configuration-only and all make lint, make typecheck, and test gates must pass by exit code.
